watch.summary: A streamer insists a pro Valorant player is only lucky and about to fail, right before the player hits an incredible shot.

beats.what: Creator claims the pro player's luck is about to run out.
Creator doubles down, stating 'He's not that good!'
The pro player hits an unbelievable no-scope headshot kill.
Creator stares in total stunned disbelief.
Creator weakly tries to stick to his story, muttering that it was still just luck.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: That's what I said, he's not that good!
watch.why: The clip uses classic hubris followed by instant contradiction as the creator discredits a pro player right before an incredible play. His stunned silence and weak double-down at the end land the comedic timing perfectly.
